details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:157-158 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The workflow hardcodes `CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS`/`CHECK_RUNS_POLL_INTERVAL_SECS` to much shorter values than the documented defaults.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently reported that this makes the collector time out far earlier than expected, so `collection_status: timeout` can occur before useful failure detail is gathered.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2079-2096 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The bytes-handling update in `fetch_log_tail()` may still be incomplete or not fully verified.
  WHY: x-ai_grok-4_20 reported that non-UTF8 log bytes could still produce malformed or empty `log_tail` output in edge cases.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2078-2085 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `timeout=60` handling is reported to leave the spawned `gh run view --log` process running after `TimeoutExpired`.
  WHY: qwen_qwen3_6-plus and x-ai_grok-4_20 warned that repeated timeouts can accumulate orphaned `gh` processes; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro disputed this and said `subprocess.run` kills and waits for the child before re-raising.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2125 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `fetch_log_tail()` is called unconditionally for every failed check-run even when `output.summary` already contains useful failure detail.
  WHY: Reviewers reported that this wastes GitHub API calls and can bloat the PR context enough to truncate the prompt.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2056-2058 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_log_tail_lines = 200` is hardcoded with no environment-variable override.
  WHY: Reviewers noted operators cannot raise the line cap without editing the workflow YAML, unlike `CHECK_RUNS_LOG_TAIL_BYTES`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2084-2089 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `ValueError` in the exception tuple is dead code.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed `subprocess.run()` does not raise `ValueError` for this call shape, so the extra catch is unreachable.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2088 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `out = proc.stdout or b""` is unnecessary.
  WHY: With `capture_output=True` and no `text=True`, `proc.stdout` is already bytes and not `None`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2084 (`except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError, ValueError):`) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `ValueError` is dead code in the except clause.
  WHY: `subprocess.run` with this call shape raises `TimeoutExpired` or `OSError`, not `ValueError`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2088 (`out = proc.stdout or b""`) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `or b""` fallback is unnecessary.
  WHY: With `capture_output=True` and no `text=True`, `proc.stdout` is already bytes and never `None`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2125 (`log_tail = fetch_log_tail(r.get("details_url") or "")`)
  PROBLEM: `fetch_log_tail` is called unconditionally for every failed check-run, even when `output.summary` already provides useful failure detail.
  WHY: This wastes one `gh run view --log --job` call per failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:157-158 (env block) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow hardcodes `CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS: '120'` and `CHECK_RUNS_POLL_INTERVAL_SECS: '30'`, but README.md documents these defaults as `1200` and `20` respectively.
  WHY: Operators following the documented defaults will experience significantly shorter wait times than documented.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2058 (`_log_tail_lines = 200`) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The line limit is hardcoded in the Python heredoc with no corresponding environment variable override.
  WHY: Operators who need more than 200 lines of log context must edit the workflow YAML directly.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2089 (`except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError, ValueError):`) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The exception handler includes `ValueError`, which is unreachable.
  WHY: `subprocess.run()` does not raise `ValueError` here; the tuple only covers real failures if `ValueError` is removed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:157-158 (env block) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow hardcodes `CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS: '120'` and `CHECK_RUNS_POLL_INTERVAL_SECS: '30'`, but README.md documents these as 1200 and 20 respectively.
  WHY: The collector will timeout after only 2 minutes instead of the documented 20 minutes.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2125: `log_tail = fetch_log_tail(r.get("details_url") or "")` | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The code unconditionally fetches `log_tail` for every failed check-run even when `output.summary` is already populated and useful.
  WHY: With multiple concurrent failures, this wastes GitHub API quota and can bloat `PR_CHECK_RUNS_CONTEXT_FILE` beyond the embed budget.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2056: `_log_tail_lines = 200` | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The 200-line truncation cap is hardcoded with no corresponding env-var escape hatch.
  WHY: Operators who need to raise the line limit must edit the workflow YAML source rather than using a repo variable.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: `fetch_log_tail()` — the `subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True, timeout=60)` call in the `try` block and the `(subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError, ValueError)` handler | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `subprocess.run`'s `timeout` parameter raises `TimeoutExpired`, but it does NOT terminate the child process.
  WHY: The spawned `gh run view --log` process continues reading the job log in the background after the handler returns `""`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: `except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError, ValueError):` | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ValueError` in this exception tuple is dead code.
  WHY: `subprocess.run` never raises `ValueError` during execution for this call shape.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: `log_tail = fetch_log_tail(r.get("details_url") or "")` inside the `for i, r in enumerate(failed):` loop | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The log-tail fetch is invoked unconditionally for every failed check-run, even when `output.summary` is already populated with useful failure detail.
  WHY: The feature wastes GitHub API quota and can bloat `PR_CHECK_RUNS_CONTEXT_FILE`, causing silent truncation mid-context.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: Lines ~2079-2096 (`fetch_log_tail() around lines 2079-2096 (last_run_diff.patch)`) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bytes-handling update from the previous autofix may still be incomplete or not fully verified.
  WHY: Non-UTF8 bytes in job logs could still cause malformed or empty `log_tail` in edge cases.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: Lines ~2078-2085 (`subprocess.run(..., timeout=60)` + except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError, ValueError)) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On `TimeoutExpired` the child `gh` process is not killed or waited for.
  WHY: Repeated slow or large-log jobs can leave orphaned `gh` processes and consume runner resources.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: `except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError, ValueError):` | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ValueError` in this exception tuple is dead code.
  WHY: `subprocess.run` never raises `ValueError` for this call shape, so the catch misstates the real failure surface.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: `for i, r in enumerate(failed): log_tail = fetch_log_tail(...)` | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The log-tail fetch is invoked unconditionally for every failed check-run, even when `output.summary` is already populated with useful failure detail.
  WHY: The extra `gh run view --log` calls waste API quota and can push `PR_CHECK_RUNS_CONTEXT_FILE` past the embed budget.
- README.md + .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: lines ~65-71 and 157-158 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Workflow defaults diverge from README documentation.
  WHY: Consumers relying on the documented values get weaker log coverage and earlier timeouts.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
